name: Elan The Presidential
summary: Existence, developer, Sector 106 Dwarka Expressway location, RERA GGM/626/358/2022/101, under-construction status, October 2027 possession, ₹5.57 Cr starting price and 8 towers are confirmed. Our 50-acre land area does not match the RERA-filed 12.767 acres (24.1-acre licensed parcel). Our 886 units differ from the 866 every source gives, and two of our unit sizes (2,750 and 3,375 sq ft) differ from the published 2,700 and 3,395 sq ft.
